title: DiffEEG: A Self-Supervised Denoising Diffusion Model for Learning EEG seizure-related Representations
abstract: arXiv:2607.11578v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep learning for EEG-based seizure detection faces critical challenges: severe annotation scarcity and extreme class imbalance, where ictal events comprise less than 10\% of clinical recordings. We present DiffEEG, a 9.6M-parameter self-supervised foundation model that addresses both limitations through denoising diffusion pre-training and reinforcement learning (RL)-based fine-tuning. Pre-trained on 1.3M unlabeled segments from the Temple University Hospital Seizure Corpus (TUHSZ), DiffEEG learns generic neural representations via a 1D U-Net with multi-head self-attention. For downstream adaptation, a reinforced decision layer employs policy gradient optimization to directly maximize F1-score, prioritizing sensitivity to rare seizure events over overall accuracy. Under strict patient-wise evaluation (279 patients, Leave-One-Fold-Out), DiffEEG achieves 61\% accuracy and 59\% F1 for 4-class seizure subtyping, and 81\% accuracy

translated_title: DiffEEG：一种用于学习脑电图癫痫发作相关表征的自监督去噪扩散模型
translated_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）的癫痫发作检测深度学习面临关键挑战：严重的标注稀缺性和极端的类别不平衡，其中癫痫发作事件在临床记录中占比不足10%。我们提出了DiffEEG，一个960万参数的自监督基础模型，通过去噪扩散预训练和基于强化学习（RL）的微调来同时解决这两个局限。该模型在天普大学医院癫痫语料库（TUHSZ）的130万个无标注片段上进行预训练，通过带有多头自注意力机制的一维U-Net学习通用的神经表征。在下游适配中，强化决策层采用策略梯度优化来直接最大化F1分数，优先考虑对罕见癫痫发作事件的敏感性而非整体准确率。在严格的患者级别评估下（279名患者，留一折交叉验证），DiffEEG在四分类癫痫发作亚型分类任务中达到61%的准确率和59%的F1分数，以及81%的准确率（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: DiffEEG是一个960万参数的自监督基础模型，通过去噪扩散预训练与强化学习微调，在标注稀缺和极端类别不平衡的条件下学习脑电图癫痫发作表征，并在患者级别严格评估中取得了优异的癫痫检测性能。
en_tdlr: DiffEEG is a 9.6M-parameter self-supervised foundation model that combines denoising diffusion pre-training with reinforcement learning-based fine-tuning to learn EEG seizure representations under severe annotation scarcity and extreme class imbalance, achieving strong performance in strict patient-wise evaluation.
